note: Two-Hand level 1 (Together) is green. Every card is right; E → Am was played clean 6 times in a row. Next on the path to smooth changes: Two-Hand level 2 (right holds, left steady) and Pattern level 5 (open 5th).

items.title: Two-Hand Trainer · 2 · Right holds, left steady
items.why: Level 1 is done. Now the right hand holds the chord while the left hand plays its pattern: the start of real two-hand independence.

items.title: Pattern Trainer · 5 · Open 5th
items.why: The open 5th (pinky + thumb) is the kumzitz left-hand sound. It unlocks the Right-Hand Trainer and the smooth changes.
